## Plan your visit

![woman viewing paintings](https://southbendart.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/05/woman-viewing-paingings.png)

## Admission is free.

We want everyone to have access to art and the opportunity to learn from it. By not charging an entry fee, we hope to make our museum more accessible to a wider range of people. We rely on the generosity of our visitors to help us continue to provide high-quality exhibitions and programming. Your support allows us to continue to share art with our community and beyond.

[DONATE](https://southbendart.org/donate/)

[MEMBERSHIP](https://southbendart.org/memberships/)

ADDRESS

120 South Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Blvd., South Bend, Indiana 46601

Located in the Century Center, on the St. Joseph River, in the heart of downtown South Bend.

Parking

Parking is available in the Century Center lot for $5 or in other nearby parking facilities or on-street parking in the downtown area.

Accessibility

All our facilities are wheelchair accessible. You may drop off passengers at the museum’s front entrance by the circle drive off Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Blvd. Tours for persons with hearing impairments are available; please call ahead.
